Players take on the role of Elena, whose fight for survival begins when she unwittingly awakens a malevolent force. About Crimson Desert  
Crimson Desert is an open-world action-adventure game developed by Pearl Abyss. A devastating ambush in the deep of night by their sworn enemies the Black Bears leaves members of the Greymanes dead or scattered across the continent. The Greymane Kliff is determined to reunite with his surviving comrades and rebuild what was lost. But on a journey where alliances are forged, dangers abound, and mysterious factions are uncovered, Kliff comes to realize that an unprecedented threat and a destiny greater than he imagined await him.

A Whisper of Fall: JinYiWei is a martial arts-themed ARPG game set in ancient China. In the game, You can use your agility to leap between rooftops and vault over walls, engage in a spectacular martial arts duel with your opponent, and even counter every move，experience the grudges and emotional entanglements of the jianghu—the unique world of martial artists. Additionally, in the game, you will be able to use the unique "deduction" ability to travel through time in each sandbox-style level, retrace different scenarios and thus experience the distinctive gameplay of overlapping possibilities.
